question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors, a 2% increase year-over-year.
items.quote: As Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors - a 2% increase year-over-year

items.text: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million the prior year; those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James reported trailing 12-month production of $538 million for recruited advisors coming into its domestic independent contractor and employee channels during the fiscal year, up from $407 million from the prior year. Those advisors represented more than $82 billion in client assets
items.scope: domestic independent contractor and employee channels

items.text: Nearly 450 advisors have earned the Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation as of September 2026; the program targets advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets.
items.quote: As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation, according to Raymond James.
items.definition: advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: Raymond James recruited a team of advisors in Southwest Florida to its Financial Institutions Division, managing about $700 million in client assets, joining from Truist Investment Services.
items.quote: Raymond James has recruited a team of advisors in Southwest Florida to its Financial Institutions Division... The team, which manages about $700 million in client assets, joins the investment program of Pinnacle Financial Partners from Truist Investment Services.

items.text: Raymond James & Associates welcomed a Washington, D.C. team from PNC Private Bank that managed over $1.5 billion in client assets.
items.quote: The team, based in Washington, D.C., arrives from PNC Private Bank, where it managed over $1.5 billion in client assets.

items.text: Two veteran Virginia wealth managers moved their practice to Raymond James & Associates, adding more than $1.2 billion in client assets to the employee advisor channel.
items.quote: Two veteran Virginia wealth managers have moved their practice to Raymond James & Associates, adding more than $1.2 billion in client assets to the firm's employee advisor channel.

items.text: Raymond James Financial Services welcomed a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network to its independent advisor channel, adding approximately $500 million in client assets.
items.quote: Raymond James Financial Services (RJFS) welcomed a five-advisor team from Commonwealth Financial Network to its independent advisor channel , adding approximately $500 million in client assets to its roster.

items.text: Jeffrey Stillwell affiliated with Raymond James Financial Services, managing approximately $240 million in client assets at his old firm, Ameriprise Financial Services.
items.quote: independent financial advisor Jeffrey Stillwell, CLU, has affiliated with Raymond James Financial Services... He managed approximately $240 million in client assets at his old firm, Ameriprise Financial Services.

items.text: A team operating as Le Sage Mattiza Maggard Wealth Management of Raymond James in The Woodlands, Texas, previously managed more than $550 million in client assets at UBS Financial Services.
items.quote: the team previously managed more than $550 million in client assets at UBS Financial Services.
items.scope: Raymond James & Associates (The Woodlands, Texas team)

items.text: Janney Montgomery Scott opened a Houston office seeded by advisors previously with Raymond James; the Edward Fitzpatrick Group had been with Raymond James for about 23 years and amassed $3.3 billion in client assets under management, plus Financial Advisor Lance Murphy overseeing more than $200 million in client assets.
items.quote: had been with Raymond James for about 23 years, during which it had amassed $3.3 billion in client assets under management... Lance Murphy will also be leaving Raymond James... he had been overseeing more than $200 million in client assets at the firm.

items.text: Four advisory practices that joined Ascentis Independent Advisors brought more than $1 billion in client assets from Raymond James Financial Services.
items.quote: has added more than $1 billion in client assets through four advisory practices that joined from Raymond James Financial Services
items.scope: Raymond James Financial Services (four practices leaving)

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm's recruiting success is spread across all its affiliation channels, including its RIA custody channel, and credited flexibility in affiliation options for the growth.
items.quote: Shoukry said the firm’s recruiting success is spread across all its affiliation channels, including its RIA custody channel. The independent contractor channel is seeing the most interest in terms of dollar volume.

items.text: Raymond James posted strong recruiting gains across its advisor channels, with CEO Paul Shoukry crediting flexibility in affiliation options for the growth.
items.quote: The firm recently posted record quarterly client assets and strong recruiting gains across its advisor channels, with CEO Paul Shoukry crediting flexibility in affiliation options for the growth.

cells.reason: Passages state the advisor headcount (record 8,943) and multiple recruiting-related facts within the 90-day window.

cells.label: different_quantity

items.text: Raymond James most recently reported it has about 8,900 advisors overseeing $1.92 trillion.
items.quote: Raymond James most recently reported that it has about 8,900 advisors overseeing $1.92 trillion.

items.text: Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount, but it had about 8,900 advisors the last time headcount was officially broken out.
items.quote: Raymond James no longer reports advisor headcount, but it had about 8,900 advisors the last time headcount was officially broken out.

cells.differs_because: Approximate ("about 8,900") figure, with one passage stating the firm no longer reports advisor headcount officially, and no specific period given; the precise figure (8,943) is captured separately as a fact.
cells.reason: These are approximate, undated headcount figures rather than the precisely stated record figure of 8,943 at fiscal year-end.
